ranks.title: Enemy Item Drop Chance
ranks.description: Enemies have a 35% chance of dropping twice as many items.

ranks.title: Upgraded Rune of Ascendance
ranks.description: 45% chance for Runes of Ascendance to be preserved when used on an item that requires at least Circle of Fortune Rank 1.

ranks.title: Idol Drop Chance
ranks.description: Whenever an Idol drops, there is a 25% chance for two more to drop at the same time.

ranks.title: Full Set Drop Chance
ranks.description: When a Set item would drop, the whole set drops instead.

ranks.title: Monolith Echo Reward Upgrade
ranks.description: 35% chance for double item rewards from Monolith Echoes.

ranks.title: Exalted Affix Chance
ranks.description: Affixes are 50% more likely to be Exalted.

ranks.title: Double Experimental Items
ranks.description: Exiled Mages drop twice as many experimental items.

ranks.title: Legendary Potential Chance
ranks.description: Uniques are twice as likely to have Legendary Potential.

ranks.title: T7 Affix Chance
ranks.description: T7 Affixes are twice as common.

ranks.title: Boss Loot Upgrade
ranks.description: Bosses have 150% increased drop rate for any specific rewards they have.

ranks.title: Rare to Exalted Chance
ranks.description: Items that would drop as Rare have a 25% chance of becoming Exalted.

ranks.title: Prophecy Reward Upgrade
ranks.description: Prophecies grant twice as many items.
